_readme: Draft Oundle walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: Oundle Museum

layers.essential_history: [[c:Oundle Museum is run by volunteers and tells the story of the town and the villages around it.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Check opening times before you go in.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:In the museum, an old map shows a hidden stair in the church tower. (Long walk only: a bonus clue.)]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The tower stair]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:A is 1, B is 2, C is 3, and so on.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:What is kept in the tower room where something could be hidden? (one word)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:2 5 12 12 19 spells BELLS. The bell chamber is a good hiding place.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:An old map shows a way up to the bell chamber in the church tower.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 270 metres as the crow flies, to South Bridge and the River Nene. Follow the road south towards the river. Take care: this road can be busy. Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
